title: Cobresal and Palestino Face Off in the Chilean Championship
subtitle: The clash pits teams in contrasting positions on the league table against each other.
excerpt: Find out everything about the clash between Cobresal and Palestino in the Chilean Championship, including recent stats and the teams' league standings.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Cobresal and Palestino in the Chilean Championship is stirring up fans and driving internet searches this Friday (28). The match will take place at Estadio El Cobre, scheduled to kick off at 7:30 p.m. Brasília time.

How the teams stand in the table

Palestino currently sits in 3rd place in the Chilean Championship, with 33 points from 20 matches. The team is trying to close the 3-point gap behind Universidad de Chile to secure second place and a direct spot in the group stage of the next Copa Libertadores.

At the other end of the table, Cobresal finds themselves in second-to-last place, with 18 points from 20 matches played. The team is fighting to escape relegation, but their recent form is a cause for concern, having recorded two draws and a defeat in their last three outings.

Different styles on the pitch

Recent statistics show very different tactical approaches from the two clubs. Palestino boasts an average of 61.3% ball possession, betting on a more measured tempo and slower passing play.

On the other hand, Cobresal averages 48.2% possession but displays a more vertical style. The home side tends to take more shots, averaging 19 attempts per game and seeking to attack with greater speed.

Match outlook and broadcast

The betting odds point to a balanced scenario with a slight edge for the visitors, Palestino, who have a 37.3% implied probability of victory compared to Cobresal's 34.9%, alongside a 27.7% chance of a draw.

For fans wishing to follow the clash in Brazil, it is worth noting that the match has no confirmed broadcast for Brazilian territory.
